title: Launch Sentry Quickstrips and KPI Concierge
body:
Purpose: quick, scannable runbook ("quickstrips") + living KPI concierge for 0→100k users launch windows. Designed for the Launch Control Room and first-48h handoff to Ops.

Scope: this doc focuses on: roadmap cadence signals, primary KPIs to watch in the control room, surge response actions, immediate rollback criteria, and the concierge checklist that surfaces owner actions in 10–60 minute windows. Not an exhaustive postmortem guide — postlaunch playbook lives under Confluence (see linked_artifacts).

Context / why this differs: we need a terse companion to the long release playbooks. During spikes, operators need a minimal checklist + KPI digest that maps thresholds to exactly one action and owner. This is that artifact.

Top-line launch goals (owner: PM + eng oncall):
- Target 95th P99 latency < 450ms for generation endpoints at baseline traffic.
- Error rate < 0.5% (5xx and model fallbacks) during first 72h.
- Token cost per request within +/- 12% of pre-ship forecast for dedicated capacity customers.
- Successful canary pass (A/B variant acceptance) for rollout cohort 1 (10% of traffic) before 24h.

Quickstrip layout (how to read):
- Column A: signal (KPI name)
- Column B: threshold band (green / amber / red)
- Column C: immediate operator action (single-sentence)
- Column D: owner (role + fallback contact)

KPI quickstrips (for the control room ticker):
1) Request throughput (RPS)
   - Green: within expected ramp ±15%
   - Amber: +15–50% -> enable burst pool (infra), notify SRE + product-ops
   - Red: >+50% -> enable global throttle, exec alert, invoke surge runbook
   - Owner: Infra lead (Liam O'Connor), fallback: SRE oncall

2) P95 latency (generation endpoints)
   - Green: < 300ms
   - Amber: 300–450ms -> validate batching windows; increase autoscale by 20%
   - Red: >450ms -> failover to lower-cost model variant or route to dedicated cluster
   - Owner: Serving-runtime lead (Ethan Wu), fallback: Infra oncall

3) Error rate (5xx + model-fallbacks)
   - Green: <0.2%
   - Amber: 0.2–0.8% -> roll forward with attention; scrub recent deployments for bad PRs; reduce traffic to canary cohorts
   - Red: >0.8% -> rollback last deployment, apply hotfix, open Sev2
   - Owner: Release eng (Priya Nair), fallback: Eng SRE manager

4) Cost-per-token delta (hosted API customers)
   - Green: +/-12% of forecast
   - Amber: 12–30% -> engage Optimize recommendations: adjust batching, quantization profile; schedule follow-up post-24h
   - Red: >30% -> temporary rate limiting on non-critical routes, alert finance-billing
   - Owner: Product Ops econ lead (Sofia Martinez), fallback: Finance analyst

5) Canary quality regression (eval suite)
   - Green: pass on 90%+ of sentinel prompts
   - Amber: 70–90% -> throttle canary, initiate targeted manual eval, notify Applied ML
   - Red: <70% -> rollback model variant, pause rollout
   - Owner: Applied ML (TBD in playbook), fallback: PM owner

Traffic surge matrix (short):
- Surge level 1 (rps +20%): enable elastic burst pool; inform CS of possible degraded latencies for customers on Dedicated; update status page note (status: investigating)
- Surge level 2 (rps +40%): progressively reduce non-critical background jobs, increase autoscale target, open surge war room Slack channel (#launch-surge-<release>)
- Surge level 3 (rps +100%): engage traffic shed policies: hold new signups for experimental flows, route lower-tier customers to lower-cost model variants. Exec notify and customer success standby.

10–60 minute concierge checklist (what to do, short actions):
T-10m (pre-press):
- Confirm telemetry dashboards are live and share link on #launch-control. Owner: product-ops (Sofia).
- Verify canary traffic split and health checks green. Owner: release eng (Priya).

T+0–10m (first-minute triage):
- Watch immediate spikes in errors and P95. If amber on any KPI, apply the corresponding amber action.
- Post a one-line summary in control channel and update the ticker. Owner: control-room operator

T+10–60m (stabilization window):
- If amber persists after 3 measurement windows, escalate to Red path and call the oncall. Owner: SRE lead
- Flag any customer-impacting errors into JIRA and start a Sev2 template if needed. Owner: incident commander

Go / No-Go signals (binary):
- Immediate NO-GO: P95 > 700ms sustained for 5m OR error-rate >2% sustained for 5m OR major regression on canary quality (<60% on sentinel set).
- Proceed with caution (soft GO): any single amber that responds to amber action within 30m and no secondary amber triggers.

Escalation and comms template (one-line messages):
- To execs (if Red): "[Release] Red: sustained error rate >0.8% and P95 >450ms. Current action: rollback candidate vX.Y. Owner: Release Eng. ETA mitigation: 18m."
- To customers (CS): "We're seeing increased latency for some requests; our engineers are actively mitigating. No customer data impact. We'll share updates every 30m."

Incident/rollback checklist (if Red):
- Freeze deploys (release-engineering)
- Capture perf traces + last 20k request logs (observability)
- Rollback last non-trivial change (release eng)
- Customer success: prepare targeted outreach list for any customers > $10k MRR on affected routes

Ownership table (single-line mappings):
- Control room operator: maintain ticker, first-line comms
- Release eng owner: rollback and canary control
- SRE/Infra: autoscale, burst pools, capacity
- Product Ops: KPI concierge, stakeholder comms
- Applied ML: quality/evals and model fallbacks
- Customer Success: customer comms and escalation

Data sources and dashboards (links & queries):
- Latency + errors: Observability dashboard (prod.latency.errors) [link copied to control channel]
- Cost-per-token: Billing forecast sheet (finance), derived query: daily_token_cost / requests_by_model
- Canary evals: nightly regression job (evals/canary-run)

Operational notes / quick TODOs before launch (action owners inline):
- Confirm status page shortcode + automated updates. Owner: SRE.
- Bake in a 10% reserved burst capacity on Dedicated clusters for first 24h. Owner: infra.
- Sanity-run the eval sentinel against the packaged model (Applied ML). Owner: Priya for verification steps.

Open questions (action required):
- Who takes primary Applied ML ownership for canary-evals during public launches? (Assigned: Maria ? — need confirmation)
- Are we comfortable with the current burst quota from cloud provider for a +75% traffic event? (Infra to verify with cloud vendor, due EOD before launch)
- Should finance opt into an emergency spend cap override for 24h post-launch? (Finance + PM decision)

Postlaunch cadence (first 72h):
- T+1h: brief check-in via control room; publish KPI snapshot to execs (product-ops)
- T+6h: full telemetry review and early anomalies list (SRE + product + applied ML)
- T+24h: cost and quality reconciliation; decide on permanent scaling changes (Infra + Finance + Product Ops)

Notes to operators:
- Keep messages in control channel terse: 2 lines max. Use the ticker template above.
- Only enact Red actions with one additional confirmation from an SRE+release eng pair.

Appendix: quick reference phrases to paste into comms (copyable):
- Exec update (short): "[Release] Status: AMBER -> Latency elevated; autoscale in progress; ETA 18m."
- Customer update (short): "We're mitigating elevated latency; no data loss; next update in 30m."

Record-keeping: paste final postmortem link into this doc and update status->final.

Last note (tl;dr): this is the short, actionable companion the control room needs. Keep it minimal, keep it updated during the launch, and treat it as living — product-ops will iterate based on first three launches.

Revision history:
- 2024-11-07: created by Sofia Martinez (draft)
- 2024-11-10: added KPI thresholds and surge matrix (Ethan Wu)
- 2024-11-12: consolidated concierge checklist and open questions (Priya Nair)
